title: Dumaahi goloh addat tan xaahi-daara
intro: Qarab baaxok xaahi golol ugutte qasriino, qaleeli exxaaxil qaxmeqe buxaaxi bicsaanamih dudda le qasriino cubbus. oson maqar kee fannaanit dadaleenih, uxih ken aydaadi qibaadah maabitinah xabcinuk asta heen. Atu ken aydaadu addat culte wak, ken kaxxiina amolladih baysi fan beyte ummatta qaddoosetto. Oson miyyak sugeenim?
clues: Nanu ardi xaahi booxaaxii kee fayyale booxaaxil, nanu ninni sigmah xisne qeedaalisso sinni duddal.
Nanu qaleelal amaan le buxaaxih weelol namixxige, faxe biyaakak amaan cussutna.
Ni addak farmoyti nee temeete Yallih niqmat nee kassiisaah digaalak nee digaala.
Nanu asta esserreeh, assakat le gaali xaak yewqe, Yallih gabat qado aqayyaare.
Nanu maabitina sadneeh, is gaali qanxisneeh, farmoytit anqasak digaalah bood abne.
Inki bakaq ni buxaaxil nee gufeeh, saaku nanu sujuudul sugne, wokkel qigdu mannowne wayne innal.
verse: So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast]. (69:5)
